text:
Munich’s median asking rent stands at 23.23 €/m², the highest of the 37 cities tracked, and rose 3.0 % year‑on‑year, adding 26.9 % over the last five years. Recent spikes and drops in momentum have been modest, with the latest month showing a stable market.

The market remains tight, with a vacancy rate of 1.4 % and listings staying on the market for just 22 days; 34 % are let within a week. Asking rents are about 80 % above the 2022 existing rent of 12.89 €/m², pushing the rent‑burden for two residents to 21.9 % and making affordability a concern.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 24.44 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 23.71 €/m² and 24.95 €/m², implying a 5.2 % increase.
